dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree linear incline relative to the dorsal midline.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curvature with a moderate radius starting from the blowhole region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby projection with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct concave notch visible at the junction where the melon meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear striations and irregular depigmented patches (rake marks) are visible across the melon and upper torso.
other_distinctive_markers: Proninent diffuse white pigmentation or specular highlights extending along the dorsal-lateral surface.
